geometry: 19 complete native quote-clock closes + current available GC midpoint; SMA20 +/- 2 sample standard deviations; UTC epoch aligned native bars
ctrader_scope: M1/M3/M6/M9 reference timeframes and SMA20/2 formula; GC midpoint is not cTrader broker Bars.ClosePrices. Built-in variance denominator unverified. ddof0 sensitivity on five predeclared calendar dates.
price_clock: canonical BBO available_ns, source publication order retained; native rollover first published quote after boundary, previous bucket closes at its last supported midpoint
support: invalid/epoch change or quote gap >60s breaks support; incomplete initial native bucket discarded; missing native buckets clear history; 19 complete preceding native bars required
crossing: strict sign reversal of price minus developing line; equality carries previous strict side, first observation is not a crossing; same publication line/scale ties retained as bit masks
motion: price-only and line-only sufficiency relative to last strict observation; PRICE, LINE, BOTH_SUFFICIENT, JOINT_NEEDED; this is moving geometry, not fixed-price barriers
event_id: SHA256 definition+source session identity prefix / full quote ordinal / scale / line / direction; independent of query, entry, side, prediction or outcome
origins: same 30s roots and causal rich_spectrum X as flow_context_v2, one unsigned L row per root; no episode selection; positive spread without upper cap
targets: next crossing packet per scale and global earliest packet strictly after decision; three line classes plus tied-lines and no-cross-by-H; global 12 scale-line classes plus tie and no-cross; unsupported future is censored, never negative
event_weighting: uniform control versus inverse number of FIT queries pointing to the same scale packet, normalized mean 1; no-cross-by-H grouped by date/scale/fixed 1800s origin block; unknown excluded; future IDs are target metadata only
split: A2: Oct-Nov -> Dec; B: Oct-Dec -> Jan-Feb; all months already development exposed; remove FIT labels whose maturity reaches evaluation boundary; assert no shared positive event IDs across splits
feature_families: geometry (5 source baseline fields plus 4x position/half-width/relative spread/native phase); rich (65 unsigned existing rich_spectrum fields +16 geometry); rich_event uses same X with event-balanced loss
entry: T: first supported full BBO publication strictly after decision+100ms, at most decision+2s, no intervening invalid/epoch/gap break; BUY ask / SELL bid, one reference oz
passive_scope: P queue execution not rerun in this comparative target experiment; existing V2 P results remain separate
profile: first crossing per scale strictly after actual entry; report decision-event and post-entry-event IDs separately, time since decision and fill, liquidation net at crossing, prefix MAE/MFE. These four marks describe one counterfactual trade, not four accumulated profits.
continuation: choose one scale before entry; exit request at its first post-entry crossing, else entry+1800s or session deadline, whichever earlier; first supported quote strictly after request+100ms within 2s; no protective fixed stop; any unresolved exposed interval censors the account
economic_model: per-scale LONG/SHORT squared-error HGB regressions for mean executed net with rich X, uniform known filled rows; expectation and realized units are USD per one reference oz
economic_policy: each scale is a separate account; choose max predicted net side >0, one position at a time until actual exit, no extra cooldown; initial capital 1500; record continuous quote MAE drawdown; halt at first selected censored outcome or nonpositive capital. WAIT=0. No selection of best realized scale.
admission: A2 >=30 fills, no selected censor and lower 95% block-day net bound >0, else B operational WAIT; raw candidate B accounts still reported separately as diagnostics
metrics: row and event-macro log loss/accuracy, majority and nearest-line geometry controls, calibration, target/prediction temporal roughness, unique events/multiplicity, CE gradients w*(p-y), economic net/time/MAE profiles, sequential equity and full-day block uncertainty
limitations: stable crossing IDs handle duplicated targets but do not make neighboring events independent, remove temporal leakage, certify broker parity, or prove predictability/profitability
